title: Trump phones Nvidia’s Huang at All-In Summit, calls data center opposition a ‘hoax’
summary_full: President Trump has been using his social media site to sound off on Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei's suggestion that the AI industry slow its pace of development.
summary_public: President Trump has been using his social media site to sound off on Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei's suggestion that the AI industry slow its pace of development.
